We read GOV.UK. It scores 92.

Give every page a canonical link, even when only one address serves it. One line settles which URL ranks.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=govuk

Bogotá city hall: SEO 97.

One site, one GA4 property, one gtag.js. If two teams need the data, share access instead of adding a tag.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=bogota

WHO's fact sheets end in a stray semicolon.

Run every JSON-LD block through a JSON validator before release. One character can void the entire block.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=who

GOV.CO is empty until JavaScript runs.

Render the main text on the server, or prerender the start page. View source should show what a visitor reads.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=govco

The BBC decides who may read it.

Blocking AI training and blocking AI answers are separate choices. Name each crawler in robots.txt on purpose.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=bbc

TransMilenio lets search write its pitch.

Write a description of about 150 characters for your ten most visited pages, starting with the home page.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=transmilenio

Python.org reads well. Its site name is missing.

Add "name" to your WebSite JSON-LD, written exactly as you want the site named in search results.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=python

Bancolombia's site won't let you zoom.

Drop maximum-scale and user-scalable=no from your viewport tag. Zoom is how many people read.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=bancolombia

The UN home page never says its language.

Put lang on the html tag of every language version: lang="en", lang="fr", lang="ar". One attribute per page.

https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=runs-2026-10&utm_content=un

NASA is wide open to AI search.

Four headers close most of that gap: Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
